description: Mark one or more time reports as invoiced, optionally linking them to an existing invoice. Requires Manager role or above.

confirm.description: Set true to perform the action. Omit or false returns a preview only — nothing is written.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key; retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

invoice_id.description: Optional ID of an existing invoice to link these time reports to.

time_report_ids.description: List of time report IDs to mark as invoiced (required, at least one).

name: mark_time_invoiced
